scripts.script:
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))()

local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({
    Name = "Brookhaven Pro Hub | Utilitários", 
    HidePremium = false, 
    SaveConfig = true, 
    ConfigFolder = "BrookhavenNormalConfig",
    IntroText = "Carregando Ferramentas Pro..."
})

-- [[ ABAS ORGANIZADAS ]]
local TabMov = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Movimentação", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998"})
local TabAuto = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Automação", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998"})
local TabTele = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Teleportes", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998"})
local TabExploit = Window:MakeTab({Name = "Exploração", Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998"})

TabMov:AddSlider({
    Name = "Velocidade de Caminhada",

        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-24, 25, -161)

        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-247, 24, -108)

        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-280, 24, 300)

-- [[ 4. EXPLORAÇÃO (NOCLIP & VISÃO) ]]

    Name = "Noclip (Atravessar Paredes)",

scripts.title: Script do pica pau
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Pica-Pau | Ação",
   LoadingTitle = "Preparando o Bico...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Modo Bicada",
   ConfigurationSaving = {Enabled = false}
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Ataque", 4483362458)
local BicoAtivo = false

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Ativar Bicada (Bico Fling)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      BicoAtivo = Value
      local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
      
      task.spawn(function()
          while BicoAtivo do
              local char = lp.Character
              local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              if hrp then
                  -- O segredo da bicada: Velocidade rotacional e de colisão
                  hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 5000, 0) 
                  task.wait(0.01)
                  hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                  hrp.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 15000, 0) -- Giro ultra rápido
              end
              task.wait(0.1)
          end
      end)
   end,
})

Tab:CreateLabel("Aproxime-se do alvo para bicar!")

Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Pica-Pau Pronto!", Content = "Modo Bicada disponível na aba Ataque.", Duration = 5})

--// MENU
local menu = Instance.new("Frame", main)
menu.Size = UDim2.new(0,130,1,-40)
menu.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,40)

--// CONTEÚDO
local content = Instance.new("Frame", main)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1,-130,1,-40)
content.Position = UDim2.new(0,130,0,40)

--// CRIAR ABA
function criarAba(nome)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", menu)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,40)
    btn.Text = nome
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)

    local frame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", content)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    frame.Visible = false
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,2000)

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", frame)
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,6)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _,v in pairs(content:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                v.Visible = false
            end
        end
        frame.Visible = true
    end)

    return frame
end

local miscTab = criarAba("Misc")

playerTab.Visible = true

scripts.script:
--// PLAYER
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

--// BOTÃO TOGGLE DO HUB
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ToggleHubUI"
gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local botao = Instance.new("TextButton")
botao.Parent = gui
botao.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
botao.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, 0)
botao.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
botao.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
botao.Text = "FECHAR HUB"
botao.TextScaled = true
botao.Draggable = true

-- estado do hub
local aberto = true

botao.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    aberto = not aberto
    
    for _,v in pairs(game.CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
        if v.Name:find("Kavo") then
            v.Enabled = aberto
        end
    end

    if aberto then
        botao.Text = "FECHAR HUB"
    else
        botao.Text = "ABRIR HUB"
    end
end)

--// CRIAR TOOL
local function criarTool(nome, func)
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = nome
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(func)

    tool.Parent = player.Backpack
end

--// KAMEHAMEHA 🔵
criarTool("Kamehameha", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local beam = Instance.new("Part")
    beam.Size = Vector3.new(3,3,15)
    beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)
    beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    beam.CanCollide = false
    beam.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-6)
    beam.Parent = workspace

    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Velocity = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 200
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(999999,999999,999999)
    bv.Parent = beam

    game.Debris:AddItem(beam, 2)
end)

--// SOCO SÉRIO 👊
criarTool("Soco Sério", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    hrp.Velocity = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 300
end)

--// GOJO PUSH 🟣
criarTool("Gojo Push", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    for _,v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= player and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            
            local targetHRP = v.Character.HumanoidRootPart

            local force = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            force.Velocity = (targetHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Unit * 150
            force.MaxForce = Vector3.new(999999,999999,999999)
            force.Parent = targetHRP

            game.Debris:AddItem(force, 0.2)
        end
    end
end)

--// OMNITRIX 🟢
criarTool("Omnitrix", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    hum.WalkSpeed = 60
    hum.JumpPower = 120

    for _,v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
        end
    end
end)

--// SUPER OMNITRIX ⚡
criarTool("Super Omnitrix", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not hrp then return end

    hum.WalkSpeed = 120
    hum.JumpPower = 250

    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
    light.Brightness = 6
    light.Range = 20
    light.Parent = hrp
end)

--// ALIEN FORCE 👽
criarTool("Alien Force", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    for _,v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.Transparency = 0.5
        end
    end

    hum.WalkSpeed = 80
end)

--// REBOOT 🔄
criarTool("Reboot Mode", function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    hum.WalkSpeed = 70
    hum.JumpPower = 150
end)

scripts.script:
--// Kavo UI Library
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()

local Window = Library.CreateLib("Kavo Hub - Brookhaven", "DarkTheme")

--// PLAYER TAB
local PlayerTab = Window:NewTab("Player")
local PlayerSection = PlayerTab:NewSection("Funções Player")

-- Speed
PlayerSection:NewSlider("Speed", "Velocidade do player", 200, 16, function(s)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = s
end)

-- Jump
PlayerSection:NewSlider("Jump Power", "Altura do pulo", 200, 50, function(j)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = j
end)

-- Reset Speed
PlayerSection:NewButton("Reset Speed", "Volta ao normal", function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end)

--// TELEPORT TAB
local TeleportTab = Window:NewTab("Teleport")
local TpSection = TeleportTab:NewSection("Locais")

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Teleport para Banco
TpSection:NewButton("Banco", "Ir para o banco", function()
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) -- mude coords
end)

-- Teleport para Hospital
TpSection:NewButton("Hospital", "Ir para hospital", function()
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(100, 0, 100)
end)

--// FUN TAB
local FunTab = Window:NewTab("Fun")
local FunSection = FunTab:NewSection("Diversão")

-- Spin
FunSection:NewButton("Spin", "Girar infinito", function()
    while true do
        wait()
        player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(10), 0)
    end
end)

-- Float
FunSection:NewButton("Float", "Flutuar", function()
    local body = Instance.new("BodyForce")
    body.Force = Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * player.Character.HumanoidRootPart:GetMass(), 0)
    body.Parent = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
end)

--// CREDITOS
local CreditsTab = Window:NewTab("Créditos")
local CreditSection = CreditsTab:NewSection("Info")

CreditSection:NewLabel("Criado por você + ChatGPT 😎")
